adopt.title: Adopt Kitchen Panel
adopt.description: Panel {device_id} found at {host}. Enter the MQTT broker details to push to it; it stores them and restarts onto your broker.

user.title: Add a panel by device id
user.description: Panels on your network are normally discovered automatically. The device id (panel-xxxxxx) is shown on the panel while it waits to be added; it namespaces the panel's MQTT topics.

error.cannot_connect: Could not push the configuration to the panel. Check that it is powered, on this network, and waiting to be added.
error.invalid_device_id: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes (up to 32).

abort.already_configured: This panel is already set up. Its address was updated; use Configure to push new broker credentials.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered panel did not report a valid device id.

init.title: Adopt panel
init.description: Pushes broker credentials to the panel over your LAN; it stores them and restarts. The address is filled in when the panel has been discovered.

error.cannot_connect: Could not push the configuration to the panel. Check the address and that it is powered and on this network.
